notes: PROOFToken has a parameterless constructor that mints all 1,000,000,000 PROOF (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units at 18 decimals) once to msg.sender. The supply is fixed forever. Transfers and approved transfers follow plain ERC-20 rules with no fee, tax or transfer limit. There is no owner, admin, post-launch minting, proxy or upgradeability. No application contracts are deployed. pool.initialPrice is provenance only; the opening price is derived from economics.initialMarketCapWei, totalSupply and the deployed currency order.
